title: 第683章 金琉璃和玉雪的震撼第682章 复活的天兆
slug: 人在废丹房我以丹药证道成仙
content_zh:
第683章金琉璃和玉雪的震撼
与此同时，在古道圣地的禁地之中。
金琉璃，玉雪仙子，乃至在此静听交谈的红仙儿，也都被这天地异象惊到了。
她们齐刷刷的看向黑光所在，脸上都露出惊讶之色。
但真正让她们不可思议的是，从那黑光之中，她们竟然都感受到一丝压迫感。
其中红仙儿就不说了，她才筑道境界，随便来一个御道境都能感受到压迫感。
但金琉璃和玉雪仙子，身为大陆巅峰强者，堂堂女帝，居然也都感受到压迫感。
这对她们来说，简直是不可思议的事情！
金琉璃柳眉微动，惊讶道。
“这天象，是从造化峰传出来的？”
在一旁的玉雪仙子若有所思的道。
“好像的确如此。”
当即，金琉璃看向一旁的红仙儿。
“怎么回事？造化峰近日有外来的强者来访？”
她本能的想到，是外来之人引发的天地异象。
然而红仙儿摇了摇头，解释道。
“没有吧，近些日叶云并未接待客人。”
“倒是叶云这几日，在寝宫之中闭关，说是有所领悟。”
闻听此话，金琉璃和玉雪仙子对视一眼。
金琉璃挑眉问道。

“玉雪道友，你觉得这会是叶云引发的天象？”
闻言，玉雪仙子沉吟了下。
很快，她微微摇头。
“这气息并不像他，不过……”
说到后面，玉雪仙子又改口补充一句。
“以那位叶长老的手段，即便真的是他，也并非什么不可思议的事情。”
毕竟对方可是能向自己保证，可以将人死而复生的家伙。
这种人身上，即便发生什么事情，也都并非不可能。
对于她的这个评价，金琉璃吃了一惊问道。
“玉雪道友，你对他评价如此之高？莫非……是与他发生过什么？”
玉雪仙子自然不可能，将自己与叶云的交易透露出来。
故而，她只是淡淡解释了一句。
“没什么，只是出于他之前的经历，觉得没什么是他做不到的。”
这一番解释，从她嘴里说出来，倒也不容置疑。
金琉璃若有所思，最后认可的点了下头。
“也是，那小子身上，确实有太多神秘之处。”
在一旁的红仙儿，则是关切的问道。
“不管怎样……我们是不是过去看一下为好？”
对此，金琉璃与玉雪仙子对视一眼，同时点了下头。
“走吧，去看看怎么回事。”

在造化峰上，突然出现让她们两位帝阶强者，都感觉到压迫的气息。
这可让她们不敢无视，当即决定去看个究竟。
content_en:
Chapter 683 The shock of Jin Liuli and Yu Xue
At the same time, in the forbidden area of the ancient holy land.
Jin Liuli, Fairy Yuxue, and even Hong Xianer, who was listening quietly to the conversation, were also shocked by this strange phenomenon in the world.
They all looked at the black light, with surprise on their faces.
But what really makes them incredible is that they all feel a sense of oppression from the black light.
Among them, Hong Xian'er will not talk about it. She just built the Dao realm, and she can feel the oppression when she comes to the Yu Dao realm.
But Jin Liuli and Fairy Yuxue, as the continent's pinnacle powerhouses and dignified empresses, actually felt oppressed.
This is simply unbelievable to them!
Jin Liuli's willow eyebrows moved slightly, and she said in surprise.
"Is this celestial phenomenon coming from Creation Peak?"
Fairy Yuxue on the side said thoughtfully.
"That seems to be the case."
Immediately, Jin Liuli looked at Hong Xian'er.
"What's going on? Has a strong person from outside visited Creation Peak recently?"
She instinctively thought that the strange phenomena in the world were caused by outsiders.
However, Hong Xianer shook her head and explained.
"No, Ye Yun has not received guests in recent days."
"On the contrary, Ye Yun has been retreating in the palace for the past few days, and he said he has gained some insights."
Hearing this, Jin Liuli and Fairy Yuxue looked at each other.
Jin Liuli asked with raised eyebrows.
"Fellow Taoist Yuxue, do you think this is a celestial phenomenon caused by Ye Yun?"
Hearing this, Fairy Yuxue pondered for a moment.
Soon, she shook her head slightly.
"This breath doesn't look like him, but..."
After speaking, Fairy Yuxue changed her words and added another sentence.
"With Elder Ye's methods, even if it is really him, it is not unbelievable."
After all, the other party is someone who can promise him that he can bring people back to life.
Even if anything happens to such a person, it is not impossible.
Regarding her evaluation, Jin Liuli was surprised and asked.
"Fellow Taoist Yuxue, do you think so highly of him? Could it be...that something happened with him?"
It was naturally impossible for Fairy Yuxue to reveal her deal with Ye Yun.
Therefore, she just explained lightly.
"It's nothing. It's just that because of his previous experiences, he feels that there is nothing he can't do."
This explanation, coming from her mouth, was beyond doubt.
Jin Liuli was thoughtful, and finally nodded in approval.
"Yes, there are indeed too many mysteries about that kid."
Hong Xian'er, who was on the side, asked with concern.
"Anyway... why don't we go over and take a look?"
In response, Jin Liuli and Fairy Yuxue looked at each other and nodded at the same time.
"Let's go and see what's going on."
On the Creation Peak, the sudden appearance made the two emperor-level powerhouses feel the aura of oppression.
This made them dare not ignore it and immediately decided to see what happened.
